Here you go @jambo

Ingredients:

16 ounces white mini-marshmallows (I use a cheap brand like a no name kind and it works fine)

2 to 5 tablespoons water (I measure it all out and keep it all in one small container for pouring)

2 pounds icing or powdered sugar (i sift it before hand to get out all lumps)

1/2 cup Crisco shortening (you will be digging into it so place in a very easily accessed bowl - not sure of the equivalent in Australia)

In a large microwavable bowl, melt marshmallows in the microwave in 30 second bursts (to stop anything burning). I do it about 3-4 times to the point it looks like it is going to overflow the big bowl i have it in.

Once the marshmallows look super puffy and melty in a big lump, i then pour enough of the water around the edge of the bowl (like in a circle around it all), this will help it to come out of the bowl easier.

I put the crisco in my kitchen aid bowl, add the marshmallow melty mix and use the hook attachment to start mixing it all - adding the icing sugar bit by bit. Chances are you won't use all the icing sugar so don't panic if that happens.

When all of the ingredients mix up and start to form one big ball in the bowl is when i stop mixing.

I then put a little crisco on my hands and get the fondant ball and start to kneed it.

After I am done with that I wrap it in glad wrap (clear plasic wrap for the americans ;) ) and make sure no air can get into it. I usually then put it in a zip lock bag to make sure no air gets in lol

If it hardens too much when you go to use it, i put it in the microwave for about 20 seconds at a time. Don't put it in longer than that at a time and make sure to check it, cause if not it will be like molten fondant in the middle and will burn the hell out of your hands (just trust me on that one).

If it gets sticky while working with it, you can dust a little icing sugar or a little corn starch - it comes down to personal choice!
